questions.question: Varun and Gaurav can dig a pond in 10 days and 18 days, respectively. After finishing that work together, they receive an amount of Rs.7,280. What is the share of Gaurav in that amount?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by Varun to dig a pond = 10 days

Time taken by Gaurav to dig a pond = 18 days

Total amount received = Rs. 7280

**Concept used:**

Amount shared will be as per the efficiency of Varun and Gaurav

**Calculation:**

LCM of 10 and 18 = 90 = Total work

Efficiency of Varun = 90/10 = 9 units/day

Efficiency of Gaurav = 90/18 = 5 units/day

Share of Gaurav = Rs. 7280 × (5/14)

⇒ Rs. 2600

**∴ Share of Gaurav is Rs. 2600**

questions.question: Varun and Syan can do a work in 3 days. Syan and Anil can do it in 4 days, and Anil and Varun can do it in 6 days. How many days will Anil alone take to do the work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

 Varun and syan can do work in 3 days

Syan and anil in 4 days

Anil and varun can do in 6 days

**Concept used :**

Per day work = total work/days required to complete the total work 

**Calculations:**

Let the total work = LCM of (3,4,6) = 12 units

Varun and syan per day work = 12/3 = 4 units

Syan and anil per day work = 12/4 = 3 units

Anil and varun per day work = 12/6 = 2 units

Adding their per day work

2 × (Varun's, syan's and Anil's) total work = 4 + 3 + 2 = 9 units 

Their total work per day = 4.5 units

Anil per day work = Total work by all - per day work of Syan and Varun

Anil per day work = 4.5 - 4 = 0.5 units

Time required by Anll to complete the work = 12/0.5 

⇒ 24 days 

**∴**** Option 4 is the correct choice.**

questions.solution:

**Calculation : **

⇒ 25/10 × 32 min

**∴ The correct answer is 80.**

questions.question: A and B working separately can do a piece of work in 21 and 24 days, respectively. If they work for a day alternately with A beginning the work, it would be completed in _________.
questions.solution:
Given:

A and B working separately can do a piece of work in 21 days and 24 days respectively.

Calculations:

Time is taken by A to complete the work = 21 days 

so part of the work done by A in 1 day = (1)/(21)

similarly, part of the work done by B in 1 day = (1)/(24)

Work done by (A + B) in 2 days = ((1)/(21) + (1)/(24)) = (15)/(168) = (5)/(56)th part of work

Work done by (A + B) in 11 pairs of days i.e.,

Work done by (A + B) in 22 day = (5×11)/(56)=(55)/(56)th part of work

Remaining work = 1 - (55)/(56) = (1 )/(56)th part of work

On the 23rd day, again A will work separately. So,

Time is taken by A to complete the (1 )/(56)th part of the work 

= (1)/(56) × 21 days 

= (3)/(8)

Total time taken = 22 + 3/8

∴ The correct answer is 22(3)/(8) days.

questions.question: A can complete a piece of work in 25 days while B can complete the same work in 30 days. They work on alternate basis, starting with A. Both A and B follow this pattern for 5 days and then A leaves the work. In how many days will B finish the remaining work?
questions.solution:
Given:

A and B can complete the work in 25 days and 30 days.

A and B work alternatively = 5 days

Formula used:

Work = Efficiency × Time

Calculation:

Total work = LCM of (25, 30)

Total work = 150 unit

The efficiency of A = 150/25 = 6 unit/day

The efficiency of B = 150/30 = 5 unit/day

A and B work alternatively for 5 days, starting with A, then

⇒ 6 × 3 + 5 × 2

= 28 unit

Remaining work = 150 - 28

Remaining work = 122

The Time taken by B to complete the remaining work = 122/5

= 24(2/5) days

∴ The required days to complete the remaining work by 'B' are 24(2/5) days.

questions.question: John can do a piece of work alone in 20 days, while Ravi can do the same piece of work alone in 28 days. In how many days can the duo complete the same work if they work together?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by John to complete a piece of work = 20 days

Time taken by Ravi to complete a piece of work = 28 days

**Formula Used:**

Efficiency = Total work/Time taken to complete the work.

**Calculation:**

Total work = LCM of (20 and 28) = 140

Efficiency of John = Total work/Time taken to complete a piece of work = 140/20 = 7

Efficiency of Ravi = Total work/Time taken to complete a piece of work = 140/28 = 5

Total time taken by them working together to complete the work = Total work/total efficiency

⇒ (140)/(7 + 5) = 35/3 = 11(2)/(3)

**∴ The correct answer is 11(2)/(3) days.**

questions.question: ​A is 20% more efficient than B. How much time will they working together take to complete a job which A alone could have done in 29 days?
questions.solution:
Given:

​A is 20% more efficient than B.

Concept used:

1. Efficiency (work done per day) of workers is inversely proportional to the time taken by workers to complete a particular task.

2. If A and B take x and y days to complete a task independently, alone they will get the work done in = xy/(x + y) days

Calculation:

According to the concept,

To complete the job alone, B will take = 29 × (1 + 20%) = 34.8 days

Working together, they will complete the work in

⇒ (29 × 34.8) ÷ (29 + 34.8)

⇒ (174)/(11) days

**∴ Working together, they will complete the work in (174)/(11) days.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**

​A is 20% more efficient than B, then efficiency of A : B = 120 : 100 = 6 : 5

A alone could have done in 29 days, then total work = (6 × 29) = 174 unit

If A and B together do the work then time takes = 174/(6 + 5) = 174/11 days

⇒ A/B = 4/5

Total work = A × 35 = 4 × 35 = 140 units

Both work together for 7 days = (5 + 4) × 7 

⇒ 9 × 7 = 63 units

Percentage job complete in 7 days = (63 × 100)/140

⇒ 9 × 5 = 45%

**∴ The correct answer is 45%.**

= 18 days + 2/3 × 24 = 18 days + 16 hours

questions.question: If A, B and C can do a work in 6 days, 9 days and 11 days, respectively, then, working together, how many days will they take to do the work?

B's work rate = 1/9 

C's work rate = 1/11

Total work = A's work + B's work + C's work

Total work = (1/6) + (1/9) + (1/11)

⇒ (33/198) + (22/198) + (18/198) = 73 / 198 

Time taken to complete the work together = 1 / Total work rate

Time taken = 1 / (73/198)

Time is taken = 198 / 73 = 2 (52)/(73) 

**∴ It would take 2 (52)/(73) days for A, B, and C to complete the work together. **

questions.question: Mira can complete a piece of work in 20 days, Nina in 30 days and Sima in 40 days. Mira and Sima worked together for 4 days and then Mira was replaced by Nina. In how many days, altogether, was the work completed?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Mira can complete a piece of work in 20 days.

Nina can complete a piece of work in 30 days.

Sima can complete a piece of work in 40 days.

Mira and Sima worked together for 4 days, then Mira was replaced by Nina.

**Formula Used:**

Work done by a person in 1 day = 1 / (Total days to complete the work)

Total work done = Sum of individual works

**Calculation:**

Work done by Mira in 1 day = 1/20

Work done by Sima in 1 day = 1/40

Work done by Mira and Sima together in 1 day = 1/20 + 1/40

⇒ Work done by Mira and Sima together in 1 day = 2/40 + 1/40

⇒ Work done by Mira and Sima together in 1 day = 3/40

Work done by Mira and Sima in 4 days = 4 × 3/40

⇒ Work done by Mira and Sima in 4 days = 12/40

⇒ Work done by Mira and Sima in 4 days = 3/10

Remaining work = 1 - 3/10

⇒ Remaining work = 10/10 - 3/10

⇒ Remaining work = 7/10

Work done by Nina in 1 day = 1/30

Now, Sima and Nina work together.

⇒ Work done by Sima and Nina together in one day = 1/40 + 1/30

⇒ Work done by Sima and Nina together in one day = 3/120+ 4/120

⇒ Work done by Sima and Nina together in one day = 7/120

Number of days required to complete 7/10 work = 7/10 × 120/7 = 12 days.

Total number of days to complete the work = 4 (Mira and Sima) + 12 (Nina and Sima)

⇒ Total number of days = 16

**The work was completed in 16 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** 

LCM (20,30,40) = 120 = Total work.

Mira does = 120/20 = 6 units of work in one day.

Nina does = 120/30 = 4 units of work in one day.

Sima does = 120/40 = 3 units of work in one day.

Now, in 4 days Mira and Sima does = 6× 4 + 3× 4 = 36 units of work. 

Remaining work = 120 -36 = 84 units.

After replacement of Mira, Sima and Nina does = 4 + 3 = 7 units in one day.

So, they complete work in 84 / 7 = 12 days.

**∴ The work gets completed in 4 + 12 = 16 days.**
